legacyDisposition.runtimePrecedence: legacy Paperclip sources are migration inputs, not the current Blentera operating contract
legacyDisposition.sunsetGate: Do not remove a legacy runtime source until every offered runtime has a reviewed destination, fresh pinned admission, collision/stale/recovery coverage, and a named owner approves the cutover.
legacyDisposition.rollback: Roll back by admitting the prior immutable Platform Skill release and restoring its pinned operation/tool contract; never mutate a published release in place.
legacyDisposition.shadowCollisionDisposition: A runtime-local or workspace Skill with reserved name blentera-platform is not a candidate override: reject unexpected source/digest and block dispatch; never merge instructions or let a local copy expand authority.
legacyDisposition.currentState: Legacy files remain in source; this register records mapping and does not claim runtime removal or installed-runtime qualification.

currentRelease.interpretation: Release compatibility metadata is a source declaration, not runtime or GA qualification.
